english.note: Use this when you want to stress that the tutor is privately engaged rather than teaching a regular class.

examples.english: We specially hired a private tutor to give me one-to-one math instruction.
examples.traditional: 我哋特別聘請咗一位私人教師，為我提供一對一嘅數學指導。
